features: 500W Powerhouse with Dolby Digital 5.1 Surround: Unleash cinema-grade audio with a massive 500W output and Dolby Digital decoding across a full 5.1 channel system — experience every explosion, whisper, and musical note with stunning clarity and power.

Deep, Room-Filling Bass with 6.5" Subwoofer Driver: The premium 6.5-inch subwoofer driver delivers floor-shaking bass while 2-inch soundbar and surround drivers provide precise mid-range and crystal-clear treble for a complete audio spectrum.

5 Versatile Inputs — HDMI ARC, Optical, Bluetooth 5.3, USB & AUX: Seamlessly connect to smart TVs, gaming consoles, streaming devices, smartphones, and more. Bluetooth 5.3 ensures stable wireless streaming with minimal latency.

LED Display & Intuitive Remote Control: The front-facing LED display provides instant feedback on volume and input mode. The dedicated remote control offers one-touch access to all functions for effortless operation.

True Dolby Digital Surround Experience: Dolby Digital decoding separates audio into distinct channels, placing sounds precisely around you for a truly immersive, theatre-quality surround sound experience at home.
